edits.old: On GKE, the Atlas Kubernetes Operator is a Kubernetes control plane for MongoDB Atlas resources. It manages externally hosted Atlas databases through custom resources rather than running database members on GKE nodes. (high confidence)
edits.new: The Atlas Kubernetes Operator is deployed into Kubernetes clusters (including GKE) and acts as a single control plane that manages resources in Atlas based on Kubernetes custom resources. The databases are Atlas deployments rather than workloads run in the Kubernetes cluster. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/atlas-operator/
